initial_observation: tip displacement under known tip force
prior: independent uniform bending and translating-base compliances
new_view_visible_base: simultaneous base marker under original tip force
push_measurement: displacement at calibrated force application location
evidence_contract: Every point model receives exactly the chosen corrective measurement. Future task load specification is known for planning; its RESPONSE and hidden parameters are never used for fitting or action selection.
uncertainty_contract: Known geometry, load magnitude, cameras and linear constitutive law; uncertainty covers bending and support compliance. Observation-noise model is calibrated by construction. Real video calibration and nonlinear mismatch are not claimed.
freeze_rule: Protocol hash and pre-action prediction/risk records are written before revealing evaluation outcomes. Development or additional sensitivity experiments must be labeled separately.
repeat_tip_target: Repeat original tip force and measure tip; other conditions predict response at 0.75 L under force applied there.
point_model_tie_rule: Uniform-prior MAP equals grid maximum likelihood; ties within 1e-9 log likelihood choose smallest Euclidean distance to prior center, then grid order.
policy_loss: Choose minimum of current posterior-MEAN failure probability and expected post-measurement posterior-MEAN failure probability plus action cost. No hard proceed gate. Mean is squared-error-optimal, not generally threshold-loss-optimal. Minimum is over declared finite action menu and numerical predictive integration.
visibility_limit: Concealed-base scenario restricts all permitted new cameras to tip marker; this is an explicit limited-access observation model, not a claim about every possible camera.
covariance_control: Fixed-budget linear variance-reduction action, always acquiring; interpret cost against this limitation.
covariance_cost_control: Cost-aware linear-MSE Markov-bound surrogate min(1,(Var(q)-Cov(q,z)^2/Var(z))/tol^2)+cost, with proceed included at min(1,Var(q)/tol^2). Uses same observations, tolerance, and action costs.
random_control: Uniform choice among one look and three pushes, fixed acquisition budget; proceed baseline and cost-aware covariance separately included.
covariance_gaussian_control: Cost-aware moment-matched Gaussian risk 2 Phi(-tol/sqrt(Var(q)-Cov(q,z)^2/Var(z)))+cost, with proceed using current variance. Same tolerance, noise and action costs. Strong simple baseline; no advantage over it assumed.
